dialogues.text_en: We have much to learn about this world. Let us see what else Visna has to share.
For a while I wasn't sure how we would fare, but it seems luck was on our side. Now we have an airship...albeit with a slew of caveats.
Back in the First, we had the Crystal Exarch to smooth over our introductions. Having no such assistance here, I must confess to feeling somewhat nervous.

Speaking of inhabitants of other reflections...the voidsent of the Thirteenth. They're generally aware of the Source and its peoples, but I suppose having no familiarity with those from another world would be the norm.
Right, let's go speak with Ketill! ...Is what I would say, but my crewmates still appear to be wary of you all.
Seeing as that wariness is why I'm getting an extra cut, just to be considerate, it'd be best if you stay put. I'll have the captain come over instead.
Captain! There's something I want to discuss with you!
Come over here! It's perfectly safe, I promise!
Well, I'll be damned... To think that there were unbranded folk...
See? It's fine, just like I said!
So, what'd you want to discuss?
First of all, we wish to apologize for any trouble we have caused. And if I may, I would explain our situation.
Uh huh... Frankly, I don't know what to think about all this “other world” stuff...
But it's true that you don't have brands. You're clearly not ordinary folk, and I reckon you could do worse than meeting Visna's master.
That being the case, we'll take you to *Naglfar*─as the stranded survivors you are.
We are truly grateful!
Huzzah!
That said, we won't be setting off just yet. This isle here's perfect for our needs.
It's our duty to gather resources in this expanse.
*Naglfar* has ships dedicated to securing materials, you see. Each vessel is assigned crew members─the captain, the pilot, the runesmith, and so on.
And it's our merry band that's been assigned to *Glaðr*!
So you will mine resources from this isle.
If you are not averse to the offer, might we assist with your work?
While poor repayment for our debt, we wish to be of service rather than sit idly by.
Well now, I won't turn down extra pairs of hands. Here, take these.
They're warm... Are these fire-aspected crystals?
Aye. Far from the purest stuff, but they've been treated to produce more heat.
As preparation for the extraction, I'd like you to set these crystals all over.
I'll have to move *Glaðr* away from the isle for the next step, so Visna will supervise here. You have any questions, you can take them to her.
Understood. We shall begin at once.
From my cursory knowledge of the subject, the mining process here appears to differ from that of the Source. It will be interesting to see how it unfolds.
While there are those in Eorzea who dwell amidst the clouds, they may descend to the surface as necessary. To think that it has been impossible here for centuries...
While you set the fire crystals, the two of us will inspect the isle. Come and find me once you've finished.
Oh, and take care not to slip and fall off the edge. You might get lucky and land on another isle...but I wouldn't bet my life on it.
In light of the battle, we need to assess the integrity of the isle's bedrock. Wouldn't want the whole thing to suddenly fall apart!
I've finished setting my allocation of crystals. If you have as well, let us report to Visna.
I wonder why *Glaðr* had to move away from the isle. If they're extracting resources, would it not make more sense to leave the ship where it was?
The bedrock appears to be sound, I'm happy to report. We can safely proceed!
Oh, you've finished already? That was fast... Do you do this sort of thing often?
An adventurer? I've never heard of such a profession. Traveling the world and taking on odd jobs... Such a life would be unthinkable here.
Tell me... Where you're from, are people free to travel as far as they like?
Or is it because you're capable that you can do that? Can travel so far, you can even come to another world...
...Sorry. We've only just met, and you're still trying to make sense of everything, yet here I am bombarding you with strange questions.
Thanks for taking care of the crystals so quickly! The captain should return very soon, so sit tight for now!
